"To accompany the annual report of the Commissioners of the District of Columbia, 1885." Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. LC copies 1 and 3 mounted on cloth backing. LC copies 2 and 3 trimmed, missing sections along edges, have printed table titled "Executive and engineer officers of the District of Columbia from the organization in 1871 to 1882 inclusive" affixed to recto, and annotated in ink and col. pencil to show names and residences of D.C. public officers. 3 copies DCP
